title: LedgerTrack legacy import: balances.jsonl line (opening balance, one per account)

decimal.description: Non-negative decimal string in major units. No sign, exponent or separators.

source_id.description: Stable id of this balance row. The opening transaction reference is import:opening:{source_id}.

amount.description: Total ledger balance, must equal available + lien.

lien.description: Must equal the sum of liens.jsonl amounts for the account.

as_of.description: Cut-off time of the legacy snapshot. Stored in transaction metadata.
